# Weekly session with Bob

Notes generated by Granola from the meeting audio.

## What came up

- Monday performance review landed hard. Bob replayed it for most of the evening.
- Core belief showing up again: colleagues can tell he is struggling and someone
  will eventually say so.
- Two thought records completed during the week. The second one helped, and he
  noticed the physical tension easing as he wrote.
- Sleep is still broken around three in the morning, and the worrying starts on
  waking rather than at bedtime.

## What seemed to shift

- Bob named the replaying as rumination himself, without prompting.
- He connected the desk to the evening, that catching it earlier is what changes
  how long it lasts.

## Follow ups

- Write the thought record at the desk, not at home.
- Try a short wind down before bed and see whether the three in the morning
  waking moves at all.
